newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PCIBank raises prime lending rate to 35 pct.
newsitem.headline: PCIBank raises prime lending rate to 35 pct.

text.p: Philippine Commercial International Bank said on Tuesday it had raised its prime lending rate to 35 percent from 21 percent last week.

An official at the PCIBank corporate banking unit said it was quoting around 30 percent last Friday when the central bank allowed a de facto devaluation by letting the peso trade within a wider range.
He attributed the high lending rate to the central bank's firm benchmark rates.
On Monday, it offered a two-week reverse repo at 25 percent. And early on Tuesday, it offered a one-month reverse repo at the same level.
